title: How Tides Work: A Short Guide
text:
How Tides Work
A short guide for curious beachgoers.
Tides rise and fall about twice a day, mostly because of the Moon's pull on the oceans.
Spring tides, the biggest, come near the full and new Moon. Neap tides, the smallest, come near the quarter Moons.
Always check a local tide table before walking out on a sandbar.
